description:
Game Director Naoki Hamaguchi and Combat Director Teruki Endo of Final Fantasy Remake/Rebirth/Revelation fame discuss their early gaming influences, the Triple A titles they played before starting work on the trilogy and how many hours they have spent playing Revelation in preparation for launch. And, of course, how, love him or hate him, Chadley came to be the major presence he is today.
